title: CustomMouse
description: This Mod adds a customizable mouse with importable textures, and customizable colors, and trails (for neoforge 1.21.1)
body:
# Custom mouse textures
- Custom size
- Custom rotation
- Custom trail color and image color
- **Custom images!!**

A very simple mod that adds customizable mouse textures ![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4db2628abd31dfae85fda4b2697894fb50247cdd_0.webp)

## By Blooperzz ^_^
